description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#977: node -e, -p, piped stdin and a Worker's eval run their code as a classic script in the global scope, as Node 22.22.0's evalScript does with vm.runInThisContext: let, const and class are in the global lexical scope (a later indirect eval sees them, const stays read-only, a second let is a SyntaxError, the TDZ holds), var is on the global in strict code too, import() still works, and vm.runInThisContext does the same
